note: Public spec documents fetched by scripts/refresh-specs.ts. Ids are gateway provider ids.

sources.notes: Official openai/openai-openapi repo (default branch main, last commit 2026-10-17). Server https://api.openai.com/v1. A JSON twin is at .../main/openapi.json. /chat/completions also has GET (list stored completions).

Azure OpenAI v1 GA data-plane spec (TypeSpec-generated, OpenAPI 3.2.0). Server is {endpoint}/openai/v1, i.e. https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1; model is the deployment name in the body. The older dated /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/chat/completions?api-version=... surface lives in
Stainless "documented" spec, served live by app.stainless.com (current). Beta variants are separate paths suffixed ?beta=true. Server https://api.anthropic.com.

Gemini API discovery document (v1beta). Paths are discovery flatPaths. The Interactions API is NOT in the discovery doc; it has its own OpenAPI file (see additionalSpecs). The OpenAI-compatible endpoint (/v1beta/openai/chat/completions) is in neither.

Vertex AI (now "Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform") discovery doc v1 (v1beta1 also at ?version=v1beta1, 5.3 MB). generateContent request is fully typed (GoogleCloudAiplatformV1GenerateContentRequest). The OpenAI-compatible chat/completions body is GoogleApiHttpBody (opaque), and rawPredict (used for Claude/partner models) is RawPredictRequest wrapping an opaque HttpBody, so neither is schema-checkable from this spec; see docs. Endpoint id for the OpenAI layer is the literal "openapi".
Same file is served at https://api.x.ai/api-docs/openapi.json and https://docs.x.ai/api/openapi.json. Server https://api.x.ai.

Served by docs.mistral.ai (current). An older copy exists at raw.githubusercontent.com/mistralai/platform-docs-public/main/openapi.yaml (661 KB, stale). Server https://api.mistral.ai (gateway also uses api.eu.mistral.ai).

Stainless spec URL taken from the last groq/groq-typescript .stats.yml that published one (commit 1df552f, 2026-06-21); newer .stats.yml files omit openapi_spec_url, so this may lag the live API by ~4 months. Server https://api.groq.com.
Stainless spec from Cerebras/cerebras-cloud-sdk-node .stats.yml (updated 2026-07-08). Server https://api.cerebras.ai. The docs site also embeds a newer per-operation spec (see additionalSpecs).
Served by docs.together.ai (the API reference .md pages cite openapi.yaml). Server https://api.together.ai/v1. No /responses or /messages path in this spec.

Stainless spec from fw-ai-external/python-sdk .stats.yml (last updated 2026-05-01; may lag). No servers block; base is https://api.fireworks.ai/inference (chat at https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions). The docs page embeds a newer chat-only spec (additionalSpecs).

Served live by the API host (server https://api.deepinfra.com). The spec lists chat at /v1/chat/completions, but the gateway code references the /v1/openai prefix and the spec has no /v1/openai/chat/completions path (only /v1/openai/videos*). Stainless spec from perplexityai/perplexity-node .stats.yml on branch next (updated 2026-07-17). Server https://api.perplexity.ai. Note chat is /chat/completions (no /v1) while responses is /v1/responses.
Stainless spec from the last SambaNova/sambanova-python .stats.yml that published one (commit 6e9c54e, 2026-06-25). Base https://api.sambanova.ai/v1.
Served from the Kimi platform docs site. Server https://api.moonshot.ai.
Served by docs.z.ai. Server https://api.z.ai/api. Coding-plan and Anthropic-compatible endpoints are not in this spec.
FastAPI spec served by the API host (no servers block); base https://api.ai21.com. Also contains many Studio app endpoints.
Served live by the API host. Server https://api.akashml.com.
Served live by the API host (no servers block; base https://api.ambient.xyz).
FastAPI spec served by https://api.arcee.ai (no servers block); also contains many /app/v1/* web-app routes to ignore.

Model APIs spec linked from the chat reference page (embedded as reference/inference-api/llm-openapi-spec.json). Server https://inference.baseten.co. Self-deployed models use a different per-deployment base URL.

Served by friendli.ai/docs. Server https://api.friendli.ai. Streaming variants appear as separate "#stream" path keys (e.g. /serverless/v1/chat/completions#stream), a Mintlify convention, not real URLs.
Served by docs.inceptionlabs.ai. Server https://api.inceptionlabs.ai. (docs.inceptionlabs.ai/api-reference/openapi.json is an unrelated Mintlify sample.)
Single-operation spec referenced by the Mintlify page https://io.net/docs/reference/ai-models/create-chat-completion. Server https://api.intelligence.io.solutions.

Llama API Stainless spec from meta-llama/llama-api-typescript .stats.yml (last updated 2025-10-01, likely stale). Spec server is http://api.llama.com while the Phaseo gateway config uses https://api.meta.ai - confirm which API the provider id targets.
Served by docs.morphllm.com. Server https://api.morphllm.com.
FastAPI spec from the Morpheus API Gateway (v1.50.0). Base https://api.mor.org.
Served live by the API host (same file at api.studio.nebius.com). Title "Nebius OpenAI-compatible inference API", version 20261015.
Served by the unified AI Endpoints host (title "OpenAI Compatible API" 0.3.11). Per-model hosts may expose their own specs.
Listed on https://docs.reka.ai/openapi.json (an HTML index, not a spec). Server https://api.reka.ai/v1. A second spec (openapi/api-reference-2.json) is the Vision Agent API.
Served by docs.relace.ai. Servers https://models.relace.ai (models) and https://api.relace.run (infra).
Served by docs.sailresearch.com. Server https://api.sailresearch.com/v1.
Served by the API host. Base https://api.venice.ai/api/v1.

"Download schema" link on the API reference. Server https://api.scaleway.ai; project_id path segment is optional in practice (examples use https://api.scaleway.ai/v1/chat/completions). curl on this machine failed the TLS chain for scaleway.com; fetched with Node.
